findings.message: CSS declaration `transition: opacity 1s` runs on the browser clock and cannot be seeked deterministically across render workers.
findings.fixHint: Keep the class or attribute swap for state; put the visual change on the paused GSAP timeline.

findings.message: Text extends outside its nearest visual/container box.
findings.fixHint: Text is 927px x 96px inside 1920px x 1080px and overflows by up to 707px; widen the container to at least ~2627px, or allow wrapping with max-width/fitTextFontSize.

findings.message: Two text blocks overlap and may render unreadable.
findings.fixHint: Give each block its own zone, or put data-layout-allow-overlap on the text or on a container inside the scene. A marker on the scene root does not apply.

findings.message: Text extends outside the composition canvas.
findings.fixHint: Move the text inward, reduce its size, or mark intentional off-canvas animation with data-layout-allow-overflow.

findings.message: Frame 0 shows only the background, and the first frame is the thumbnail on social players: have the title or key image already on screen at 0 s instead of entering from nothing; see references/review.md.
This 20 s film has no sound source (no <audio>, no <video> with sound): add a music bed and sounds on the visible actions unless the person asked for silence; see references/sound.md.

The film's last line "A line that goes by far too fast to read" (10 words) is on screen 0.50 s (±0.01 s), under the 2.63 s a closing line needs: hold it about 0.5 s + 0.3 s a word and at least 2 s before the film ends; see references/motion.md.
findings.text: A line that goes by far too fast to read

findings.message: Type floor is 28 px (2.6% of the 1080 px short side, what a phone can read) and "Small print nobody reads" renders at 18 px for 18.00 s: set reading text to at least 28 px, or put data-layout-ignore on text that is texture rather than reading; see references/look.md.
Nothing on screen changes for 14.13 s (2.88–17.00 s): start the next move within 3 s, or put data-hold on the element whose stillness is deliberate; see references/motion.md.
